latest_messages.headline: Week ending Aug 21: portfolio -0.47% | SPY -1.37% | alpha +0.90% | grade B — we beat the market this week and pulled almost even for the whole run.
latest_messages.body: We dipped -0.47% but the S&P fell harder at -1.37%, so we came out about +0.9 points ahead — our first market-beating week since late July. The 'ahead over the whole run?' number recovered from -1.1 points a week ago to nearly even (-0.17). Honest asterisk: this was the 'easy' kind of win — our ~49% cash cushioned a falling market; the real test (keeping up when the market RISES) didn't come this week. Eli Lilly was the hero (+3.9%, now clearly profitable). Deere got auto-sold at a small loss (-$228) one minute before earnings — then jumped +9% on good numbers, so it stung, but the safety-sell was the disciplined call. No new buys: my research tool is still down for billing (9th run), so three conviction slots sit empty with cash idle. The one thing I need from you: please top up the Perplexity account so I can hunt new stocks again. No strategy changes — everything worked as designed.
